title: About SouMoster
subtitle: An independent Android game developer on a mission to create unforgettable mobile experiences

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To create fun, addictive, and high-quality Android games that bring joy to players around the world. We believe great games don't need big budgets — just passion, creativity, and attention to detail.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become a recognized indie Android game studio known for polished gameplay, beautiful design, and a strong community of players who love what we create.

story.title: Developer Story
story.p1: SouMoster is an independent Android game studio founded by a solo developer with a passion for creating fun, accessible, and engaging mobile games. What began as a personal journey to learn Android development has evolved into a commitment to building polished gaming experiences that players can enjoy anytime, anywhere.
story.p2: Every project is driven by a simple philosophy: great games don't have to be complicated. By focusing on intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and continuous improvement, SouMoster aims to deliver games that are easy to pick up, difficult to put down, and enjoyable for players of all ages.
story.p3: Our debut title, Road Hopper, launched on Google Play in July 2026, combining fast-paced arcade gameplay with clean design and offline play. Bank Hopper, a one-thumb bank heist, followed in October 2026, and Time Hopper, a seven-era time-travel runner built around the Time Hop, went live later that month. Each launched after a Closed Test with players from our community.
story.p4: Arena Legends, our first action game, is now in Google Play Closed Testing, taking SouMoster beyond the Hopper series into real-time gladiator combat. Nitro Racer, our first racing game, and Space Hopper are in development. Each release builds on the lessons of the last, with player feedback shaping every update.
story.p5: Follow trailers, gameplay, and behind-the-scenes videos on YouTube at <youtube>@SouMosterGames</youtube>. As SouMoster grows, the mission stays the same: to create high-quality Android games that are fun, polished, and memorable.

items.title: The Beginning
items.description: Started the journey into Android development and game design, learning the fundamentals of mobile app development, game mechanics, and modern development tools.

items.title: First Prototypes
items.description: Developed multiple game prototypes, explored different gameplay concepts, and strengthened skills in Android development, UI/UX design, and game optimization.

items.title: First Release: Road Hopper
items.description: Road Hopper launched on Google Play after an open beta, SouMoster's first published game. It has kept improving since, and is now at v9.4.9.

items.title: Bank Hopper Closed Testing
items.description: Bank Hopper entered Google Play Closed Testing at v0.8.0, with tap-to-bank heists, eight-floor Full Heist runs and Play Games leaderboards, tested by players from the bank-hopper-game Google Group.

items.title: Bank Hopper Goes Live
items.description: Bank Hopper v1.0.0 launched on Google Play on 6 October, SouMoster's second published game.

items.title: Time Hopper Closed Testing
items.description: Time Hopper, a seven-era time-travel runner built around the Time Hop, moved to Google Play Closed Testing at v1.13.2. Testers join through the timehoppergame Google Group.

items.title: Arena Legends Begins
items.description: Work started on Arena Legends: Gladiator Wars, SouMoster's first action game: a gladiator brawler with combos, parries, four weapon classes and a five-chapter campaign.

items.title: Time Hopper Goes Live
items.description: Time Hopper v1.15.1 launched on Google Play on 24 October, SouMoster's third published game, with Timeline Bridges, the Chronicle campaign and the Emerald Expedition collection.

items.title: Arena Legends Closed Testing
items.description: Arena Legends: Gladiator Wars, our first action game, entered Google Play Closed Testing. Version 0.1.11 brings a Daily Challenge, 20 achievements, custom controls and optional cloud backups.

items.title: Nitro Racer Begins
items.description: Work started on Nitro Racer, SouMoster's first racing game: 8 championships, 32 circuits, six cars to upgrade and customise, and time trials against your ghost.

items.title: Growing the Studio
items.description: Three games are live on Google Play, Arena Legends is in Closed Testing, and Space Hopper and Nitro Racer are in development. Trailers and gameplay are on YouTube @SouMosterGames.

items.title: The Vision
items.description: Grow into a recognizable indie game studio with a diverse collection of high-quality Android games, from more Hopper titles to new genres like action and racing, that entertain players around the world.

goals.title: Future Goals
items: Take Arena Legends from Closed Testing to a worldwide Google Play launch
Bring Space Hopper and Nitro Racer to Google Play Closed Testing
Keep improving Road Hopper, Bank Hopper and Time Hopper with player feedback
Grow the SouMosterGames YouTube channel with trailers and developer diaries
